stem.text: Which statement about Group 17 elements and their compounds is correct?

A.text: Chlorine reacts with cold concentrated sodium hydroxide to form $\text{NaCl}$ and $\text{NaClO}_3$.

B.text: $\text{HCl}$ is more thermally stable than $\text{HBr}$ because chlorine is less electronegative than bromine.

C.text: Iodide ions are oxidised to iodine by concentrated sulfuric acid.

D.text: Silver iodide is soluble in dilute aqueous ammonia.
